verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch documents an official CLI that runs API tests and automated monitoring from a terminal "or through an automated system" (docs-8, docs-21, docs-31, probe-4). `hopp test` can generate JUnit reports, which suits CI pipelines (docs-9). missing for 10: explicit CI-platform integration docs or examples (e.g. GitHub Actions), details on exit codes and headless environment and secret handling, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
